exposure: Comprehensive management of severe Asherman syndrome, including preoperative hysteroscopy, ultrasound-guided intraoperative procedures, postoperative estrogen supplementation, and IVF & ET
Comprehensive management approach (including preoperative hysteroscopy, ultrasound-guided surgery, postoperative estrogen therapy, and IVF & ET for some)
cohort: Four infertile women with severe Asherman syndrome
finding: Comprehensive management, including surgical correction and assisted reproductive technology, resulted in successful conception in all four women with severe Asherman syndrome, although only two achieved term pregnancies.
mod_finding: Two out of the four women had term pregnancies with cesarean section, one due to placenta previa and the other due to placental abruption.
